$comment: WebMCP tool definitions for a fictional marketing agency ('Northwind Growth Co.'). JSON has no comments, so explanations live in '$comment' keys, which JSON Schema reserves for notes and validators ignore. Register each entry with document.modelContext.registerTool({...definition, execute}) - see docs/WEBMCP-EXPLAINED.md. Strip '$comment' and 'x-' keys first if your WebMCP library rejects unknown fields. WebMCP is a draft spec; check https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/ before shipping.

agency.name: Northwind Growth Co. (fictional)
agency.$comment: Illustrative example. Replace every value with your own services, prices and policies.

tools.name: discover_seo_services
tools.title: Find SEO packages
tools.description: List this agency's SEO packages that fit a goal, monthly budget and timeframe. Read-only: does not contact anyone or create a lead.
tools.$comment: Descriptions are read by agents to choose a tool, so state what it does AND what it does not do.

query.description: What the person wants, in their words, e.g. 'rank for product pages on a Shopify store'.
query.$comment: Free text lets the agent pass nuance the structured fields miss.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Maximum monthly spend in US dollars.
monthly_budget_usd.$comment: Units in the field name prevent the agent from sending '5k' or euros.

timeframe_months.description: How long the engagement should run.

industry.description: Client industry. Use 'other' if none fit.
industry.$comment: Enums stop agents inventing categories you can't match.

no_match_reason.$comment: When nothing fits, say why (e.g. 'minimum budget is $2,000/month') so the agent can adjust instead of guessing.

tools.name: discover_ppc_services
tools.title: Find paid-media (PPC) packages
tools.description: List paid-media management packages for the given ad channels, monthly budget and industry. Read-only.

channels.description: Ad channels the person wants managed.

monthly_management_budget_usd.description: Budget for the agency's management fee, in US dollars.
monthly_management_budget_usd.$comment: Kept separate from ad spend: agents (and people) often confuse the two.

monthly_ad_spend_usd.description: Expected media spend paid to ad platforms, in US dollars. Used to recommend a tier.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.title: Get case studies
tools.description: Return published, client-approved case studies for a service type and industry. Read-only. Only returns material the client has approved for public use.
tools.$comment: Never return unapproved client names or results: an agent will repeat whatever you return.

approved_claims.$comment: Only claims your legal/compliance team approved, verbatim. Agents quote these.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get pricing tiers
tools.description: Return current price tiers for a service and scope. Read-only. Prices are in US dollars and exclude tax unless stated.
tools.$comment: Exact, current prices are what make an agent willing to recommend you. Include terms, not just numbers.

scope.description: Engagement size. Omit to get all tiers.

purchasable_by_agent.$comment: True only for fixed-price, fixed-scope offers you are happy to sell without a sales call.

tools.name: submit_agency_inquiry
tools.title: Send an inquiry to the agency
tools.description: Send a project inquiry to the agency on the person's behalf. Creates a lead and the agency will reply by email. Ask the person to confirm their details and consent before calling. Does not take payment.
tools.$comment: The one tool with side effects. readOnlyHint is false so agents and browsers treat it with care; the page should also ask the person to confirm (the draft spec has a user-interaction API for this).

package_id.description: Package from discover_seo_services / discover_ppc_services, if one was chosen.

message.description: The person's goals and context, in their words.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true: the person agreed to be contacted about this inquiry.
consent_to_contact.$comment: Makes consent explicit and auditable. Check your regional marketing-consent rules.

submitted_by_agent.description: Name of the AI agent or app submitting, for attribution, e.g. 'Claude' or 'ChatGPT'.

next_step.$comment: Tell the agent what happens next, e.g. 'A strategist will email within 1 business day.'
